current_screen.title: CURRENT — Confusing Order Edit Flow
sections: Header Bar (Orange #E8622A with back arrow and Table 4)
Previously Ordered section (Expanded by default, taking 55% screen height, 3 items: Cappuccino x2 ₹320, Flat White x1 ₹160, Organic Espresso x1 ₹120, total ₹600)
New Items section (Spanish Latte x1 ₹200 buried down page)
Confusing Price Breakdown (Item Total ₹800 without split, CGST ₹20, SGST ₹20, Grand Total ₹840)

callouts.title: Problem 1: Visual Monopolization
callouts.text: Previously ordered items dominate top view. The customer already knows they ordered these.

callouts.title: Problem 2: New Item Buried Below Fold
callouts.text: The single item just added (Spanish Latte) requires scrolling to verify or edit quantity.

callouts.title: Problem 3: Bill Ambiguity (₹800 Shock)
callouts.text: Item Total shows ₹800 without attributing ₹600 to previous order. Looks like Spanish Latte alone costs ₹800!

proposed_screen.title: PROPOSED — Clear, Item-First Edit Flow
sections: Header Bar (Orange #E8622A with back arrow and Table 4)
New Items section FIRST (Green accent, Spanish Latte x1 ₹200 prominent with clear stepper)
Previously Ordered COLLAPSED Pill ('🔒 Previously Ordered · 3 items · ₹600 ▼' with interactive toggle)
Clear Price Breakdown ('New additions ₹200' + 'Previous order ₹600' + thin line + 'Item Total ₹800' + CGST ₹20 + SGST ₹20 + 'Grand Total ₹840')

callouts.title: Fix 1: Focus On New Additions First
callouts.text: Immediately validates what was just clicked. Customer sees Spanish Latte at ₹200 right at the top.

callouts.title: Fix 2: Compact Collapsed Row
callouts.text: Condenses 3 items into a single neat row (3 items · ₹600). Tap to expand anytime.

callouts.title: Fix 3: Transparent 2-Part Price Split
callouts.text: Explicit breakdown: New additions ₹200 + Previous order ₹600 = Item Total ₹800. No ambiguity.

expanded_modal_or_drawer.title: Interactive Inspection: Previously Ordered Section When Expanded
expanded_modal_or_drawer.description: When the customer taps the collapsed row on the Proposed design, it smoothly slides down showing all 3 locked items with item statuses, quantities, and read-only lock cues.

interactive_features_in_html.live_toggle_collapse: Clicking the Previously Ordered pill in the PROPOSED phone dynamically expands/collapses the items with smooth animation
interactive_features_in_html.quantity_stepper_interaction: Clicking '-' or '+' on Spanish Latte recalculates the New Additions (₹200 -> ₹400), Item Total (₹800 -> ₹1000), CGST/SGST (₹25), Grand Total (₹1050), and button label in real time
interactive_features_in_html.annotation_toggle: Show/Hide Annotations toggle button on top canvas for clean presentation vs design critique mode
interactive_features_in_html.expanded_demo_viewer: Dedicated section showing exact styling of expanded items inside the new clean design

instructions_to_main_agent: Generate /app/frontend/public/review-order-comparison.html as a self-contained, responsive, pixel-accurate static HTML presentation using modern Tailwind CSS via CDN, Google Fonts (Montserrat), and SVG icons.
Render TWO exact 390px mobile screens side by side: LEFT = CURRENT (with red critique markers and callouts) and RIGHT = PROPOSED (with green enhancement badges and callouts).

Implement real working JavaScript inside the HTML: toggling the collapsed pill in the Proposed screen smoothly opens and closes the previously ordered items; tapping +/- stepper adjusts prices dynamically so reviewers can test edge cases.
Below the side-by-side phones, provide a high-res 'Expanded State Component Spec' with design tokens, exact margin/padding dimensions, font weights, and accessibility notes.
Ensure contrast complies with WCAG AA and APCA standards. Brand orange #E8622A must use crisp white text #FFFFFF for buttons and headers.
Add annotations pointing directly from the outer margins to the corresponding UI cards on both phones.
Verify the file is created at /app/frontend/public/review-order-comparison.html and accessible.
